items.html: *Now we shall explain what is the existence of the beard of Arich Anpin. It is known that Arich Anpin clothes the Atik, as above. And we have already explained that Arich Anpin has a skull, and it is the secret of the Keter of Arich Anpin; and in it there is one brain alone, which is not divided into three brains as in Zeir Anpin, but one alone. And this brain is the secret of the Hochma of Arich Anpin, and it is called the hidden Mocha (Mocha Stimaa).
